name: Obfuscate — 2 Intermediate — Vanish from the Mind's Eye

system.description: You gain the benefits of Unseen Presence even while speaking or moving, and may declare a mass Mental Challenge against onlookers (bidding a Mental Trait per onlooker) at the end of a turn to fade from view entirely, regardless of their Auspex.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
